title: Travel: Planning, Places and Getting Around

words.exam_focus_zh: 听力旅游场景常考行程安排，阅读中也常与 schedule、route 等表达形成同义替换。

senses.definition_en: a detailed plan of a journey, including the places to visit and the times of travel

synonyms.nuance_zh: schedule 更强调时间安排，可用于会议、交通等；itinerary 专指旅行路线和景点安排。
travel plan 更笼统、口语化；itinerary 通常指较详细的书面行程。
synonyms.collocation: draw up a travel plan（制定旅行计划）

examples.sentence: The conference pack includes a detailed itinerary, so delegates know exactly where each session will be held.
examples.translation_zh: 会议资料包里有详细行程表，因此代表们清楚每场会议将在哪里举行。
examples.note_zh: 听力或阅读中 itinerary 常与 detailed、proposed 等搭配，注意拼写。

examples.sentence: Rather than following a fixed itinerary, we preferred to explore the coastal villages at our own pace.
examples.translation_zh: 我们没有按照固定行程走，而是更喜欢按自己的节奏探索沿海村庄。
examples.note_zh: rather than 对比结构可用于表达旅行偏好，适合口语 Part 2。

words.exam_focus_zh: 阅读中常考“容纳、适应、满足需要”等多义辨析，听力住宿场景也常出现 accommodation。

senses.definition_en: to provide someone with a place to stay or enough space for people
to change your plans or provide what someone needs

synonyms.nuance_zh: house 更强调提供建筑或场所居住；accommodate 更正式，也可指容纳人数。
meet 常与 needs、demand 搭配，偏中性；accommodate 更正式，强调通过调整安排来照顾需求。

collocations.meaning_zh: 接待客人；为客人提供住宿

examples.sentence: The hotel can accommodate up to 300 guests, but during peak season rooms must be booked well in advance.
examples.translation_zh: 这家酒店最多可容纳300位客人，但在旺季必须提前很久订房。
examples.note_zh: accommodate 表示“容纳”，听力住宿场景注意数字和预订信息。

examples.sentence: Good urban design should accommodate the needs of cyclists as well as drivers.
examples.translation_zh: 良好的城市设计应满足骑行者以及驾驶者的需求。
examples.note_zh: 写作中可用于城市规划话题，accommodate the needs of 是正式搭配。

words.exam_focus_zh: 阅读中常考“偏远的”与“远程的”两个义项，注意根据上下文区分，也常与 isolated 同义替换。

senses.definition_en: far away from towns and cities

senses.definition_zh: 远程的；通过互联网进行的
senses.definition_en: done through a computer network from a distance

synonyms.nuance_zh: isolated 强调与外界联系少；remote 只强调距离远，不一定完全隔绝。
distant 可指空间、时间或关系远；remote 更常修饰地区、地点。

word_forms.meaning_zh: 远程地；稍微（常用于否定）

examples.sentence: For people in remote areas, access to reliable public transport remains a serious challenge.
examples.translation_zh: 对偏远地区的人来说，获得可靠的公共交通仍然是个严峻挑战。
examples.note_zh: 阅读和写作常用 remote areas，注意 access to 的搭配。

examples.sentence: The survey found that employees who worked remotely at least two days a week reported higher job satisfaction.
examples.translation_zh: 调查发现，每周至少远程工作两天的员工表示工作满意度更高。
examples.note_zh: remotely 是副词，注意与 remote working 的替换关系。

words.exam_focus_zh: 听力和阅读交通场景高频词，常与 traffic jams、crowding 同义替换，写作中常讨论如何解决拥堵。

senses.definition_en: the state of being too full of traffic
the state of being too full or blocked with people or things

synonyms.nuance_zh: overcrowding 多指人或空间拥挤，不常指车辆交通；congestion 可指交通或人群。
traffic jam 可数，指具体一次堵车；congestion 不可数，指拥堵状态。
synonyms.collocation: be stuck in a traffic jam（遇上堵车）

examples.sentence: The city introduced a congestion charge to reduce traffic in the historic centre.
examples.translation_zh: 该市引入了拥堵费，以减少历史城区的交通流量。
examples.note_zh: congestion charge 是城市交通话题中的常见表达，听力中注意专有名词。

examples.sentence: Cycling to work not only cuts congestion but also improves air quality.
examples.translation_zh: 骑自行车上班不仅能减少拥堵，还能改善空气质量。
examples.note_zh: not only... but also 结构适合写作中列举双重好处。

words.exam_focus_zh: 口语 Part 2/3 描述旅行地点时的高分习语，阅读中也常与 remote、less crowded 等表达同义替换。

senses.definition_zh: 远离常规路线的；小众的
senses.definition_en: far from the places most tourists visit; unusual or secluded

synonyms.nuance_zh: secluded 强调安静隐蔽，适合描述地点；off the beaten track 强调避开大众旅游路线，不一定完全隐蔽。
out of the way 强调不方便、需要绕路；off the beaten track 常指避开大众旅游路线，带探索意味。
synonyms.collocation: a bit out of the way（有点偏远或绕路）

collocations.phrase: a place off the beaten track

examples.sentence: We spent a week exploring villages off the beaten track, where local customs are still very much alive.
examples.translation_zh: 我们用一周时间探索小众村庄，那里的当地习俗仍然很有活力。
examples.note_zh: off the beaten track 可作后置定语，口语中可替换 crowded tourist spots。

examples.sentence: Although the hotel is slightly off the beaten track, the peaceful surroundings make it well worth the journey.
examples.translation_zh: 虽然这家酒店位置有点偏，但宁静的环境让它非常值得一去。
examples.note_zh: although 让步结构，well worth 是地道表达。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Have you sorted out your trip to Portugal yet?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Almost. I've drawn up a rough itinerary, but I'm trying not to plan every hour.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Good idea. Are you staying in Lisbon the whole time?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Only for three nights. The hotel can accommodate four, so my sister and her partner are joining us.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Nice. Will you hire a car?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: We thought about it, but driving in the city centre can be a nightmare because of the congestion. We'll take the train to a few remote villages instead.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That sounds much more interesting. Anywhere in particular?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: A friend recommended a place off the beaten track near the border—apparently the local market is amazing and there are hardly any tourists.

quiz.question: The hotel can only ______ up to 80 guests during the conference season.
quiz.explanation_zh: accommodate 表示“容纳”，符合句意；congest 是“使拥堵”，remote 是形容词，itinerary 是名词“行程表”。

quiz.question: Which is closest in meaning to “off the beaten track” in “They chose a village off the beaten track”?
options: far from the usual tourist routes
easy to reach by public transport
quiz.explanation_zh: off the beaten track 指远离大众旅游路线、较为小众的地点，与 far from the usual tourist routes 意思最接近。
